intro: Oohinchaledhayya is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & sung by Raj Chikkala, music composed by Enoch Jagan & produced by Samy Pachigalla. This song was released on February 15, 2022 through Samy Pachigalla YouTube Channel.
